answers.explanation: The source-visible behavior is partly established. DocumentViewSet requires an authenticated principal and PaperlessObjectPermissions. download delegates the requested pk to file_response. That path loads request_doc, derives root_doc, and explicitly applies owner-aware view_document authorization to root_doc. Owner-aware authorization succeeds when the root is ownerless, owned by the authenticated user, or covered by an object grant; those runtime facts are unspecified. Only after that check, the code resolves file_doc: a version-addressed request without a version query keeps request_doc, while an explicit version may select the root or a member of that root's version family. The returned bytes then come from file_doc.archive_file by default when available, or file_doc.source_file when original=true or no archive exists. Thus selecting original versus archive changes only the representation of the same file_doc, but selecting another version can change the Document whose file is returned without a shown exact-object view_document check on that selected file_doc. Exact runtime outcome additionally depends on pk/version validity, family membership, deletion visibility, file existence, archive availability, and the unspecified ownership/object grants.
